verdict: REPORTED NULL (>=1 no-refit family missed its frozen bound)
claim_language: A PASS is a same-simulator, different-load-law, no-refit, baseline-subtracted closure: B_eff_force is fit only to the cubic concentrated-tip-load law on the residual after subtracting a MEASURED self-weight settle (the baseline reuses the gravity channel as data, not as the sag law); a common multiplicative g/mass scale error cancels; it is NOT a solver-, clamp-, continuum-EI-, or hardware-independent validation.

finding5_attribution.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- explains the force-vs-gravity B_eff gap; does NOT change the REPORTED NULL verdict.
finding5_attribution.B1_note: B1 (softest in-cohort) deviates more -- larger self-weight deflection -> geometric nonlinearity beyond lumped-mass r_N.
finding5_attribution.interpretation: Gravity B_eff was fit from distributed self-weight on a lumped-mass rod, biased LOW by the quadrature factor r_N; the tip point-load force calibration has no distributed-mass quadrature bias, so B_eff_force ~= B_continuum, HIGHER than gravity B_eff by ~r_N. The calibration-window mean r_N (~6.5%) accounts for most of the +7.8% mean gap; the ~1.3% residual is unexplained. Because 4th-root boundaries shift only ~1.9% under a ~7.8% B_eff rescale (within the declared grid bound), the prefactor(b)/distal(c) no-refit predictions PASS while the direct-sag(a) misses.
